newsitem.title: USA: USDA seeks 1.224 mln lbs frozen ham for lunches.
newsitem.headline: USDA seeks 1.224 mln lbs frozen ham for lunches.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it plans to buy 1,224,000 lbs of frozen smoked fully cooked hams (Type II) for use in the National School Lunch Program.
All offers must be in the format prescribed in LS-50 and be received by 1400 EDT in Washington, D.C., on Tuesday, October 15. Acceptances will be announced by midnight Friday, October 18.
Shipments must be made between November 27 and December 10, the AMS said.
